_comment: D1 dual-arm MANIPULATION HOME -- the arms' ready pose for manipulation: the pose teleop (dx-vr-teleop) and policy inference (d1-inference) start from and return to. It is NOT the base HOME in home_pose.json, which stays the rest pose of omakase-core and every CSV gesture (gestures pin home_pose.json as first and last keyframe, so changing THIS file regenerates nothing). Measured on d1-8 (right arm, arm B) and mirrored onto arm A, so it is exactly mirror-symmetric by construction: B = A * MIRROR_SIGN, sign-flipped on J1/J3/J5/J7 and equal on J2/J4/J6. Same format and conventions as home_pose.json: 14 arm joint angles in DEGREES, executable order ArmSide::A then ArmSide::B (A = physical left, B = physical right); gripper is controlled separately. Guard-checked by tests/guard (body, chest and self clearance) and FK-pinned in tests/guard/test_urdf_fk.py. Limits (Lite, deg): J1/J3/J5 +/-173, J2 +/-118, J4 -145..+45, J6 +/-60, J7 +/-90, J7 narrowed by J6 per coupled_joint_limits.json.
